mechanism: Request-local shared-prefix reward and measured-round cost selection among budgets1..configured2/3. Keep existing0.4 confidence stop. First try each unmeasured budget once in descending order; thereafter select largest empirical committed-tokens/round-ms ratio, tie larger. Actual cost observations belong only to executed requested budget. No fabricated counterfactual costs, confidence-as-acceptance or cross-request learning.
shared_feedback_proof: After completed nonterminal round with proposed n and accepted a, budget k output count is1+min(a,k) when k<=n; also known for all larger k if a<n (first rejection already observed), or n<requested (confidence stopped). If all n accepted and n=requested<k, larger-arm reward is unobserved and is not updated. Histories condition future estimates; no stationarity or optimality guarantee.
scope: Enable only max_new_tokens>=64 to bound three-arm startup exploration on short generation; shorter requests keep incumbent. This fixed horizon boundary is not fitted or scanned. Tail-limited, stop/cancel/failure rounds do not update learning. Costs include full transaction and observers. Select effective budget before begin; no target/draft arithmetic changes or new allocation.

correctness_repair.stage: source audit before any API timing
correctness_repair.finding: Sharing outcome-known higher-budget rejections while censoring their unknown successful continuations would downward-bias higher-arm rewards. Exact individual labels do not make selected sample means unbiased.
correctness_repair.final_rule: Eligibility is k<=requested, independent of current acceptance/confidence outcome. Every eligible smaller budget has reward1+min(accepted,k), including confidence-shortened rounds. Do not update any larger budget from this round, even when its reward is inferable. Costs remain actual-arm only.
correctness_repair.tests: Enumerate every possible unseen continuation to establish eligible rewards, and assert repeated short-arm rejection cannot change larger-arm counts/sums.
correctness_repair.scope: One declared correctness repair; no alternate policy or parameter scan. Native mixed-budget state check exercises unchanged control/numerical code; final policy selected only after host recheck and realAPI.
